# PulseWatch

> PulseWatch by OrangeCloud monitors public mentions of people, brands, products, and companies, then classifies sentiment and sends alerts for important negative mentions.

PulseWatch is a multi-tenant social listening app. It watches the public web, news, blogs, forums, and RSS. A social source is included only when public or official access exists. It does not bypass login, CAPTCHA, or private groups.

Canonical site: https://reputation.orangecloud.vn/
Vietnamese page: https://reputation.orangecloud.vn/vi/
Maintainer: Cường Lê Sỹ (https://orangecloud.vn/#person)
Hub: https://orangecloud.vn/

## Notes for agents

- workers.dev hostnames are not the canonical site.
- Do not claim full coverage of Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, or private communities.
- Plan prices are shown on the English homepage. This file does not restate them.
- robots.txt disallows training crawlers. Search and answer crawlers may read the public pages.
